claim_ceiling: Repairs Active Path report freshness and classification truth only. It does not add, restore, delete, move, reroute, or normalize files; it does not change owner authority, helper authority, Bank, Continuous Run, storage, or persisted user data; and it requires fresh iPhone proof after deployment.

observed_facts.fact: The user exported pmp-discovery-report-2026-08-25T06-43-54-409Z.zip after a fresh August 25 app session, but its internal canonical discovery report was the prior report started 2026-08-01T23:01:47.818Z and finished 2026-08-01T23:01:55.098Z with reason diagnostic_coverage_pass_a.
The old exporter returned a previously stored valid report before calling the canonical machine, so Run Discovery Again and ZIP export did not guarantee a new scan.
All 23 entries previously labelled hard_missing were HTTP 200 reachable rows absent from the old Atlas registry; reachability was being conflated with registry membership.

All 10 entries previously labelled dead_reference returned HTTP 412; the old scanner placed every non-OK response into dead_references without separating precondition/integrity-policy rejection from 404/410 missing.

inferred_conclusions.conclusion: A user-requested discovery operation must be bound to a unique scan ID and must call the canonical machine even when a complete stored report exists.

A reachable file absent from the Atlas registry is an ATLAS_REGISTRY_GAP, not HARD_MISSING; 404/410 may support MISSING, while 412 must remain PRECONDITION_REJECTED and fail closed only when it blocks a required current lane.
Current Map roles are stronger lane evidence than filename heuristics and should classify current boot/runtime, tool/support, recovery, and historic routes before fallback heuristics are applied.

cases: valid stale August-1-style stored report exists before a requested scan
two consecutive explicit scan requests must return different scan IDs
reachable unregistered source becomes ATLAS_REGISTRY_GAP and not HARD_MISSING
HTTP 412 source remains PRECONDITION_REJECTED and is excluded from dead/missing
known-absent/historic source is not promoted to current hard missing
genuine current failure keeps freeze gate false
returned scan identity must match requested scan identity
